description:
The person the records are about: the child whose doses are given, signed, registered, verified and shared. Acts through the caregiver, holds no device and plays no lane in the journeys' processes.

**Persona**: A newborn whose vaccination history must follow him across a border he cannot speak for.

**Also known as**: Patient; Care recipient

**Played in the journeys by** (fictional):

- ![Somsack](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) [Somsack](personas.html#somsack-baby--the-record-follows-him-lao-pdr), Somsack SENGMANY (newborn)

**In the user scenarios**:

- [J1 — Born abroad](scenarios.html#j1--born-abroad-thailand-birth-day): J1 A Lao baby is born in Thailand
- [J2 — Found at home](scenarios.html#j2--found-at-home-lao-pdr-3-weeks-later): J2b Registered at home, and referred
- [J4.1 — Crossing back: a Thai doctor sees the full history](scenarios.html#j41--crossing-back-a-thai-doctor-sees-the-full-history-chiang-rai-12-months-later): J4.1 A Thai doctor sees the full history
